title: Oil Drilling Services and Micro Strategy Deep Dive Analysis

claims.claim: Loose conditions coexist with expensive risk.
claims.reason: A conditions index partly includes equity prices, creating circularity when used to explain those same prices. Independent bank and funding components need isolation.

claims.reason: For unchanged local revenues, a fall in the local-currency cost of dollar debt reduces servicing burden mechanically. Actual investment performance also depends on hedges and earnings.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Narrow deductive identity only; no empirical forecasting credit.

assumptions: Dollar debt payment D is fixed
Exchange rate e is local currency per dollar
proof.derivation: Local debt service equals e*D. A lower e reduces this cost by D times the exchange-rate change.

framework_lessons: Distinguish business recovery from share valuation.
assessment: The bitcoin direction and continued Halliburton profitability have evidence, while the profit-recovery premise failed through 2025. The five-year service-stock thesis remains open. Premium discipline is sensible but cannot be counted as a winning switch without matched returns.
